name: 时态
desc: 一般时、进行时、完成时与被动

items.point: 一般现在时：第三人称单数
items.rule: 主语是 he/she/it 或单数名词时，动词加 -s / -es。
items.wrong: He go to school by bus.
items.right: He goes to school by bus.

items.point: 一般现在时：否定与疑问
items.rule: 否定和疑问用 does，后面的动词回到原形。
过去发生的事用动词过去式，常见加 -ed。
items.wrong: I walk to the park yesterday.
items.right: I walked to the park yesterday.

items.rule: I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。
am/is/are + 动词 -ing，表示正在发生。
was/were + 动词 -ing，表示过去某一刻正在进行。
items.wrong: I was cook when you called.
items.right: I was cooking when you called.

items.rule: have/has + 过去分词，强调对现在的影响。
for 接一段时间，since 接时间点。
items.wrong: I have lived here since three years.
items.right: I have lived here for three years.

items.rule: had + 过去分词，表示比另一个过去动作更早。
items.wrong: She had left before I arrive.
items.right: She had left before I arrived.

items.rule: will 后面永远接动词原形。
be going to 后面接动词原形，表示打算。
items.wrong: We are going to visited the museum.
items.right: We are going to visit the museum.

items.rule: have/has been + 动词 -ing，表示一直持续到刚才。
items.wrong: I have been wait for an hour.
items.right: I have been waiting for an hour.

items.wrong: English is speak in many countries.
items.right: English is spoken in many countries.

items.rule: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用将来时。
items.wrong: If it will rain, we will stay home.
items.right: If it rains, we will stay home.
